_om: Sjakkhesten in English (Knightly, rusj.no/en/knightly/): chess. The move list uses English piece letters (K Q R B N). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Mobilen gjør mange tabber og lar brikker: The phone makes lots of blunders and leaves pieces hanging. Good for learning.
Mobilen slår når den kan, men ser ikke l: The phone takes whenever it can, but doesn't look far ahead. A nice first opponent.
Ser noen trekk fram og straffer feil. Pa: Looks a few moves ahead and punishes mistakes. A fair challenge.
Tenker dypt. Klarer du å slå den?: Thinks hard. Can you beat it?
Kongen til svart står i sjakk og kan ikk: Black's king is in check and can't escape.
Kongen til hvit står i sjakk og kan ikke: White's king is in check and can't escape.
Svart kan ikke flytte, men står ikke i s: Black can't move, but isn't in check. That makes it a draw.
Hvit kan ikke flytte, men står ikke i sj: White can't move, but isn't in check. That makes it a draw.
Den samme stillingen kom tre ganger. Da: The same position came up three times. That makes it a draw.
50 trekk på rad uten slag eller bondetre: 50 moves in a row with no capture or pawn move. That makes it a draw.
Ingen av dere har nok brikker igjen til: Neither of you has enough pieces left to checkmate.
Klokka til svart gikk ut, men hvit har f: Black's clock ran out, but White doesn't have enough pieces to checkmate.
Klokka til hvit gikk ut, men svart har f: White's clock ran out, but Black doesn't have enough pieces to checkmate.
Godt kjempa! Prøv igjen – eller velg et: Well fought! Try again – or pick an easier level.
Sjakk for to på samme mobil – eller mot: Chess for two on the same phone – or against the phone at four levels. Whoever checkmates the king wins.
Trykk på en brikke. Prikkene viser hvor: Tap a piece. The dots show where it can go. Tap the square you want – or drag the piece there.
Flytt til en rute med en av motstanderen: Move onto a square with one of your opponent's pieces and it's taken. A ring shows what you can take.
Står kongen i sjakk uten å kunne komme u: If the king is in check and can't escape, it's checkmate – and the game is won.
Rokade: Har verken kongen eller tårnet f: Castling: if neither the king nor the rook has moved, the king can go two squares towards the rook – and the rook jumps over the king.
En passant: Går en bonde to ruter fram o: En passant: if a pawn moves two squares and lands next to one of your opponent's pawns, it can be taken as if it had moved just one square – but only on the very next move.
Kommer en bonde helt fram, velger du hva: When a pawn reaches the far end, you choose what it becomes – usually a queen.
Remis (uavgjort): patt, samme stilling t: A draw: stalemate, the same position three times, 50 moves with no capture or pawn move, or too few pieces left.
Mot mobilen på nybegynner og lett viser: Against the phone on beginner and easy, red rings show which of your pieces could be taken, and ‘Tips’ suggests a move.
Trykket feil? «Angre» tar tilbake trekke: Tapped the wrong square? ‘Undo’ takes the move back.
Hvordan vil du spille?: How do you want to play?
Spiller 1 begynner med hvit. Dere bytter: Player 1 starts as White. You swap colours every game.
Hver av dere har {n} minutter på hele pa: You each have {n} minutes for the whole game. The clock starts once White has moved.
Uten klokke tenker dere så lenge dere vi: With no clock, you can think as long as you like.
Den som skal flytte, har alltid sine bri: Whoever's turn it is always has their pieces at the bottom.
Vent litt – mobilen tenker: Hang on – the phone is thinking
Kongen står i sjakk – den må reddes førs: Your king is in check – save it first
Mobilen vinner dette partiet. Du kan all: The phone wins this game. You can always start a new one.
The result counts towards the score.
